scope: Canonical published formula families directly overlapping mechanisms or controls explored in this project. This is a scientific prior-art screen, not an exhaustive bibliography or a legal novelty/patent opinion.
eligibility_rule: A final Sigma candidate must be one equation or one action with the same universal constants and matter coupling in every system. A regime transition is acceptable only when it is derived from a field invariant evaluated identically everywhere; object labels, per-object gravity parameters, a lens-only multiplier, or choosing a different published law after seeing the target are not acceptable.

families.name: Newtonian Poisson gravity
families.canonical_formula: nabla^2 Phi = 4 pi G rho; g = -nabla Phi
families.mechanism: One scalar potential sourced linearly by mass density.
families.source_title: Philosophiae Naturalis Principia Mathematica
families.overlap_note: Baseline for every weak-field Sigma law and for the Newtonian control row.

families.name: General relativity
families.canonical_formula: G_mn + Lambda g_mn = (8 pi G/c^4) T_mn
families.mechanism: One spacetime metric is sourced by the full stress-energy tensor and governs matter and null geodesics.
families.source_title: Die Feldgleichungen der Gravitation
families.overlap_note: Mandatory high-field and one-metric limit; v17 spatial-stress sourcing starts from the GR fact that stress, not only rest density, enters T_mn.

families.name: Brans-Dicke scalar-tensor gravity
families.canonical_formula: S proportional to integral sqrt(-g)[phi R - omega phi^-1 (grad phi)^2] + S_m
families.mechanism: A dynamical scalar changes the effective gravitational coupling in a covariant action.
families.source_title: Mach's Principle and a Relativistic Theory of Gravitation
families.overlap_note: Broad prior art for Sigma scalar actions and running effective G; a renamed scalar alone is not novel.

families.name: Bekenstein conformal/disformal matter metric
families.canonical_formula: g_tilde_mn=A(phi,X)g_mn+B(phi,X) nabla_m phi nabla_n phi
families.mechanism: Matter follows a physical metric related conformally and disformally to a gravitational metric.
families.source_title: The Relation between Physical and Gravitational Geometry
families.overlap_note: Direct prior art for NBM0 A1 and any claim that a conformal/disformal physical metric is itself a new Sigma mechanism.

families.name: MOND acceleration law
families.canonical_formula: mu(g/a0) g = g_N; mu(x)->x for x<<1 and mu(x)->1 for x>>1
families.mechanism: Acceleration-dependent interpolation between Newtonian and deep-MOND regimes.
families.source_title: A modification of the Newtonian dynamics as a possible alternative to the hidden mass hypothesis
families.overlap_note: Direct prior art for fixed RAR/MOND, low-acceleration powers, variable exponents, and any a0-gated enhancement.

families.name: AQUAL nonlinear Poisson gravity
families.canonical_formula: div[mu(|grad Phi|/a0) grad Phi] = 4 pi G rho
families.mechanism: A nonlinear kinetic term in an action produces MOND while preserving conservation laws.
families.source_title: Does the missing mass problem signal the breakdown of Newtonian gravity?
families.overlap_note: Direct parent of Sigma refracted/gated AQUAL, tensor AQUAL, nonlinear p-Laplacian, and several potential-screened laws.

families.name: QUMOND
families.canonical_formula: nabla^2 Phi = div[nu(|grad Phi_N|/a0) grad Phi_N]; nabla^2 Phi_N = 4 pi G rho
families.mechanism: A nonlinear algebraic operation on the Newtonian field becomes the source of a second linear Poisson solve.
families.source_title: Quasi-linear formulation of MOND
families.overlap_note: Direct prior art for source-routing and potential-channel QUMOND tests and component-wise nonlinear source construction.

families.name: Empirical radial acceleration relation
families.canonical_formula: g_obs = g_bar/[1-exp(-sqrt(g_bar/g_dagger))]
families.mechanism: Empirical one-variable map from baryonic to observed radial acceleration in rotating galaxies.
families.source_title: The Radial Acceleration Relation in Rotationally Supported Galaxies
families.overlap_note: The RAR term in the current empirical bridge is published input, not a Sigma invention.

families.name: Navarro-Frenk-White halo
families.canonical_formula: rho(r) = rho_s/[x(1+x)^2], x=r/r_s
families.mechanism: Collisionless-dark-matter simulations motivate a cusped two-scale halo profile.
families.source_title: The Structure of Cold Dark Matter Halos
families.overlap_note: Comparator and source of some derived cluster targets; it is not a baryon-only explanation.

families.name: Burkert cored halo
families.mechanism: A phenomenological cored halo profile with object-level density and radius scales.
families.source_title: The Structure of Dark Matter Haloes in Dwarf Galaxies
families.overlap_note: Prior art for cored effective-halo shapes that a Sigma response might accidentally reproduce.

families.name: Einasto-like halo profile
families.canonical_formula: rho(r)=rho_-2 exp{-(2/alpha)[(r/r_-2)^alpha-1]}
families.mechanism: A continuously varying logarithmic density slope fitted to simulated halos.
families.source_title: The Inner Structure of LambdaCDM Halos III: Universality and Asymptotic Slopes
families.overlap_note: Comparator for smooth effective-halo shapes; not a baryon-only mechanism.

families.name: Pseudo-isothermal halo
families.canonical_formula: rho(r)=rho_0/[1+(r/R_c)^2], giving an asymptotically flat circular-speed tail
families.mechanism: A cored isothermal-like halo supplies an approximately 1/r outer acceleration.
families.regime_logic: per-halo fitted density and core radius
families.source_title: Extended rotation curves of spiral galaxies: dark haloes and modified dynamics
families.overlap_note: Direct comparator for the project's baryon-normalized isothermal-tail formulas; sharing the radial shape is not a new mechanism.

families.name: Hernquist spherical mass profile
families.canonical_formula: rho(r)=M a/[2 pi r(r+a)^3]; Phi=-GM/(r+a)
families.mechanism: Analytic finite-mass spherical profile approximating an r^(1/4) stellar system.
families.source_title: An Analytical Model for Spherical Galaxies and Bulges
families.overlap_note: Known source-profile geometry; using it is not a new gravity law.

families.name: TeVeS
families.canonical_formula: S=S_g[g]+S_s[g,phi]+S_v[g,U]+S_m[g_tilde(phi,U,g),psi]
families.mechanism: Tensor, vector, and scalar fields define one physical matter metric and recover MOND plus lensing.
families.source_title: Relativistic gravitation theory for the MOND paradigm
families.overlap_note: Major prior art for any Sigma scalar-vector-tensor action, metric slip, and unified matter/light response.

families.name: Extended MOND
families.canonical_formula: A0=A0(Phi) inside a generalized AQUAL/MOND action
families.mechanism: The MOND acceleration scale depends on gravitational potential to enhance cluster-scale response.
families.source_title: Unifying all mass discrepancies with one effective gravity law?
families.overlap_note: Direct prior art for potential-moving thresholds, U0 EMOND-like laws, and H7 potential-dependent AQUAL.

families.name: Refracted Gravity
families.canonical_formula: div[epsilon(rho) grad Phi] = 4 pi G rho
families.mechanism: A density-dependent gravitational permittivity redirects and strengthens the field in low-density environments.
families.source_title: Dynamics of galaxies and clusters in refracted gravity
families.overlap_note: Direct prior art for every density/permittivity Sigma or RG term, including the current empirical bridge.

families.name: Covariant Refracted Gravity
families.canonical_formula: S proportional to integral sqrt(-g)[phi R - omega(phi) phi^-1 (grad phi)^2 - 2 V(phi)] + S_m
families.mechanism: A scalar-tensor completion makes the effective gravitational response density/environment dependent.
families.source_title: Covariant formulation of refracted gravity
families.overlap_note: Closest published covariant parent for density-dependent Sigma/RG combinations.

families.name: Scalar-Tensor-Vector Gravity (MOG)
families.canonical_formula: g(r)=GM/r^2 [1+alpha-alpha(1+mu r) exp(-mu r)] for a point source
families.mechanism: Running scalar couplings plus a massive vector yield an enhanced large-scale force with Yukawa structure.
families.regime_logic: dynamical fields; phenomenological point-source parameters in applications
families.source_title: Scalar-Tensor-Vector Gravity Theory
families.overlap_note: Direct prior art for Yukawa tails, Proca vectors, running G, and EMOG-Q0.

families.name: Conformal gravity galactic potential
families.canonical_formula: V(r) approximately -beta c^2/r + gamma c^2 r/2 - kappa c^2 r^2/2
families.mechanism: Fourth-order conformal field equations add linear and quadratic potential terms.
families.source_title: Linear Potentials and Galactic Rotation Curves - Formalism
families.overlap_note: Prior art for additive long-range potentials and unbounded radial running.

families.name: Nonlocal gravity with reciprocal kernel
families.canonical_formula: G_mn + integral K(x,x') G_mn(x') dx' = 8 pi G T_mn/c^4 (schematic)
families.mechanism: A causal memory kernel changes how source information contributes over spacetime separation.
families.source_title: Observational Tests of Nonlocal Gravity: Galaxy Rotation Curves and Clusters of Galaxies
families.overlap_note: Broad prior art for Sigma path memory, diffusion, Helmholtz memory, causal catch-up, and nonlocal basin laws.

families.name: Verlinde emergent-gravity apparent dark response
families.canonical_formula: integral_0^r [G M_D(r')^2/r'^2] dr' = a0 M_b(r) r/6 (spherical isolated form)
families.mechanism: An elastic/entropic response associated with baryonic displacement produces an apparent dark component.
families.source_title: Emergent Gravity and the Dark Universe
families.overlap_note: Prior art for elastic-medium and baryon-induced response interpretations.

families.name: Gravitational polarization / dipolar dark matter
families.canonical_formula: div(g - 4 pi G Pi) = -4 pi G rho_b; Pi aligned with g in equilibrium
families.mechanism: Gravitational dipoles polarize around baryons and reproduce MOND-like behavior.
families.source_title: Model of Dark Matter and Dark Energy Based on Gravitational Polarization
families.overlap_note: Close conceptual prior art for polarization, permittivity, and field-line redirection, although it introduces a dark medium.

families.name: Einstein-Aether gravity
families.canonical_formula: S proportional to integral sqrt(-g)[R + K^{ab}_{mn} nabla_a u^m nabla_b u^n + lambda(u^2+1)]
families.mechanism: A unit timelike vector supplies a dynamical preferred frame through a covariant action.
families.source_title: Gravity with a dynamical preferred frame
families.overlap_note: Direct prior art for EA-Q0 and all Sigma aether, clock, preferred-frame, and vector-stress constructions.

families.name: AeST relativistic MOND
families.canonical_formula: S proportional to integral sqrt(-g)[R - (K_B/2)F_mn F^mn + scalar-aether kinetic terms - F(Y,Q)] + S_m[g]
families.mechanism: A metric, unit vector, and scalar reproduce MOND and cosmological dark-sector phenomenology.
families.source_title: A new relativistic theory for Modified Newtonian Dynamics
families.overlap_note: Explicit parent action for the Sigma v8-v10 AeST extensions; those extensions cannot claim the base AeST structure.

families.name: Chameleon screening
families.canonical_formula: Box phi = V_,phi + beta rho/M_Pl; m_eff^2=V_eff,phiphi(rho)
families.mechanism: Environmental density changes a scalar's effective mass and suppresses its force in dense regions.
families.source_title: Chameleon Fields: Awaiting Surprises for Tests of Gravity in Space
families.overlap_note: Prior art for automatic density/environment screening and EMOG-Q0.

families.name: Symmetron screening
families.canonical_formula: V_eff(phi)=1/2(rho/M^2-mu^2)phi^2+lambda phi^4/4; A(phi) approximately 1+phi^2/(2M^2)
families.mechanism: Density restores or breaks a symmetry, making the scalar-matter coupling vanish or activate dynamically.
families.source_title: Symmetron Fields: Screening Long-Range Forces Through Local Symmetry Restoration
families.overlap_note: Direct prior art for the tested conformal symmetron and for smooth density activation derived from one action.

families.name: Galileon with Vainshtein screening
families.canonical_formula: L includes (grad pi)^2 Box pi/Lambda^3 plus higher Galileon invariants
families.mechanism: Derivative self-interactions suppress a scalar near massive sources while allowing infrared modification.
families.source_title: The galileon as a local modification of gravity
families.overlap_note: Prior art for Sigma Vainshtein, cubic Hessian, Galileon, and nonlinear kinetic screens.

families.name: dRGT massive gravity
families.canonical_formula: S=(M_Pl^2/2) integral sqrt(-g)[R+m^2 sum_n beta_n e_n(sqrt(g^-1 f))]
families.mechanism: A tuned nonlinear potential gives a massive spin-2 field without the usual extra ghost in its intended domain.
families.source_title: Resummation of Massive Gravity
families.overlap_note: Direct prior art for Sigma v7 positive spin-2, cubic Hessian, and physical-metric projection attempts.

families.name: Degenerate higher-order scalar-tensor theory
families.canonical_formula: S=integral sqrt(-g)[f(phi,X)R + sum_I alpha_I(phi,X)L_I(phi_mn)] with a degenerate kinetic matrix
families.mechanism: Higher derivatives avoid an Ostrogradsky mode only when action coefficients obey degeneracy conditions.
families.source_title: Degenerate higher derivative theories beyond Horndeski: evading the Ostrogradski instability
families.overlap_note: Direct prior art for Sigma v3A, v5C, and v12 same-clock DHOST constructions and their rank/constraint gates.

families.name: Symmetric teleparallel / coincident gravity
families.canonical_formula: S_GR=-(16 pi G)^-1 integral sqrt(-g) Q; modified models use f(Q)
families.mechanism: Gravity is encoded in nonmetricity with a flat, torsionless connection; nonlinear f(Q) generalizes the action.
families.source_title: Coincident General Relativity
families.overlap_note: Direct parent geometry for Sigma v1-v2 nonmetricity actions; the base Q formulation is published.

families.name: MOND-like fractional Laplacian gravity
families.canonical_formula: (-Delta)^s Phi = -4 pi G ell^(2-2s) rho; s=3/2 gives a MOND-like point-source limit
families.mechanism: A fractional spatial operator changes the Green function and long-distance force scaling.
families.regime_logic: fixed operator order or prescribed running
families.source_title: MOND-like Fractional Laplacian Theory
families.overlap_note: Direct prior art for NBM0 A5 and any fractional nonlocal Poisson proposal.

families.name: Multi-fractional spacetime galaxy gravity
families.canonical_formula: S proportional to integral d^D x v(x) sqrt(-g)[R+...] with scale-dependent geometric coordinates/derivatives
families.mechanism: An anomalous spacetime measure or derivative structure changes the galactic potential across scales.
families.source_title: Gravitational potential and galaxy rotation curves in multi-fractional spacetimes
families.overlap_note: Prior art for variable distance exponents and scale-dependent geometry.

families.name: Superfluid dark matter
families.canonical_formula: P(X) proportional to X sqrt(|X|); phonons couple to baryons and mediate a MOND-like force in the condensed phase
families.mechanism: A physical dark component changes phase, producing MOND-like galactic phonons but particle-like cluster behavior.
families.source_title: Theory of Dark Matter Superfluidity
families.overlap_note: Important comparator showing that a real universal phase transition is not the same as an object-label oracle, though it violates the baryon-only goal.

families.name: f(R,T) gravity
families.canonical_formula: S=(16 pi G)^-1 integral sqrt(-g) f(R,T) + integral sqrt(-g) L_m
families.mechanism: The gravitational action depends explicitly on curvature and the trace of the matter stress-energy tensor.
families.source_title: f(R,T) gravity
families.overlap_note: Prior art warning for v17: making gravity depend on a scalar constructed from baryonic stress is not novel by itself; the exact spatial-stress invariant and predictions must be distinguished.

families.name: Energy-momentum-squared gravity
families.canonical_formula: S=(16 pi G)^-1 integral sqrt(-g)[R - eta T_mn T^mn] + S_m (representative form)
families.mechanism: A scalar quadratic in stress-energy enters the action and modifies the metric and matter equations.
families.source_title: Energy-Momentum Squared Gravity
families.overlap_note: Closest broad prior art to a response involving sqrt(S_mn S^mn); Sigma must not claim stress-squared coupling in general as new.
